integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D-animated, cinematic, After-Effects-style motion-graphics title sequence on a deep black canvas. Stylized comic-book pages flip and rotate open with a glowing red and electric-blue light sweep, kinetic-typography fragments drifting across the frame. The camera holds a slow push-in as faint comic-panel grid lines and floating ink particles build the sense of a hero roster assembling. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera cuts to a dynamic side view: Spider-Man, a young man in a red-and-blue masked suit with white webbing lines, swings in from the upper left on a silver web-line, legs tucked, and lands in a crouch on a glowing rooftop ledge while his mask fabric rustles. [Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to Captain America, a broad-shouldered man in a blue tactical uniform with a white star on the chest and a winged helmet, hurling his round metallic shield; the shield spins with a high-pitched whir and ricochets off an unseen surface with a sharp metallic clang before snapping back into his gauntleted hand. [Shot 4] At 00:09.000, the camera pulls out with large amplitude at fast speed to reveal an ensemble of main heroes striking heroic poses on a rising light platform — Iron Man in red-gold armor with a glowing repulsor, Thor with a crackling lightning hammer, plus the two earlier heroes — as gold light flares burst between them and embers swirl upward. [Shot 5] At 00:12.000, all motion freezes into a comic splash-page composition as a bold title card slams in from the right: "MARVEL" in thick white capital letters with a red underline streak and a lens-flare glow, particles cascading across the screen, holding until the 15.00-second mark.

overall_soundscape: A low whoosh of pages turning and air rushing accompanies the opening flips, followed by a web-line zip and a soft landing thud. The shield hums and clangs against metal, with rapid footwork and fabric movement underlying the hero assembly. Light crackles and ember pops punctuate the finale.

non_diegetic_music: A heroic orchestral fanfare at a fast tempo, built from brass stabs and pounding timpani over a driving string ostinato, swelling to a bright cymbal crash as the title card lands.
